_note: Text for the build page and the level map, in ASD-STE100. {act} is "Click" on a laptop and "Tap" on a phone. {pin}, {rail}, {part}, {n}, {total}, {a} and {b} are filled in by the app. Write all text so that a person who never saw a circuit can follow it: short words, one idea in each sentence.

wire.start: {act} a glowing hole. This is where the wire starts.
wire.finish: {act} the other glowing hole. This is where the wire ends.

resistor.start: {act} a hole for the first leg of the resistor.
resistor.finish: {act} a hole for the second leg, 2 to 10 holes away from the first.

led.start: {act} a hole for the long leg of the light (+).
led.finish: {act} a hole next to it for the short leg (−).

stop.phone: Tap the same hole again to stop.

speaker.start: {act} + on the screw terminal of the amplifier, or a hole, for the + lead of the speaker.
speaker.finish: {act} − on the terminal, or a hole, for the − lead.

module.start: {act} a glowing hole for pin 1 of the {part}. The shadow shows where the part goes.
module.preview: Look at the shadow. {act} the same hole again to put the {part} there, or tap a different hole.

problem.covered: You cannot use this hole. The ESP32-S3 board is on top of it.
problem.esp_pin: The board already has a pin in this hole. Use an empty hole in the same line of 5.
problem.taken: This hole is full. Each hole holds only one thing.
problem.led_span: The LED legs are short. Use a hole 1 to 3 holes from the long leg.
problem.resistor_span: Use a hole 2 to 10 holes from the first leg.
problem.nothing_to_remove: There is no part in this hole.
problem.no_hole: Use a hole on the breadboard.
problem.part_pin: A part already has a pin in this hole. Use an empty hole in the same line of 5.
problem.under_part: You cannot use this hole. A part is on top of it.
problem.off_board: The part does not fit here. Some pins are off the breadboard. Move pin 1.
problem.rail_pin: Put the pins of this part in the middle of the breadboard, not on a rail.
problem.needs_gap: This part must go across the center gap, with pins on the two sides. Move pin 1.
problem.on_gap: This part must stay on one side of the center gap. Move pin 1.
problem.on_part: The part would go on top of another part. Use a different place.
problem.esp_line: A pin of this part would touch a pin of the board. Move the part to lines that have no board pin.
problem.socket_leg: Put the legs of this part in the breadboard. Use a wire to go from the breadboard to a pin of the board.

hole.line: These 5 holes are joined under the board. What you put in one hole touches the other 4.
hole.railLine: All the holes on this long line are joined.
hole.empty: Nothing connects to this line yet.
hole.pinTip: To use this pin, put a wire in an empty hole in the same line of 5.
hole.socketTip: To use this pin, put one end of a wire into it.
hole.railEmpty: Nothing connects to this rail yet.
hole.partTip: To use this pin, put a wire in an empty hole in the same line of 5.
hole.terminalTip: This is a screw terminal. Put a speaker lead or a wire into it.

intro.how: Follow the yellow arrow. It shows where to click or tap. Holes that blink are holes that you can use.

mistake.wrong_wire: Oops, this wire goes to the wrong place. Undo it, then use the glowing holes.
mistake.wrong_part: Oops, this is not the part for this step. Undo it, then read the pop-up again.
mistake.wrong_place: Oops, this part is in the wrong place. Undo it, then put it where the pop-up says.

ready.title: All tasks are done
ready.text: Press Check. The app tests all your wires.

play.saveError: We could not save your progress. Your board is still saved on this device.
play.otherTab: This level is open in another tab. This tab stops saving. Reload this page to see the newest board.

check.missing_ground: {a} does not go to the blue − line. Add a wire from it to the blue − line.
check.wrong_pin: {a} does not go to {b}. A wire is missing, or it is in the wrong hole.
check.noHearts: You have no hearts left. You can check again. If the next Check fails, you get 3 new hearts.
check.refilled: You get 3 new hearts. Read the reason above, then try again.
check.noSession: We could not save your Check, because this level has no saved session. Go back to the level map, then open the level again.
check.error: We could not save your Check. Try again.
check.empty: Place a part on the board first. Check tests the parts that you place.

map.lockedHint: Pass level {n} to open this level.
